note: Hand-graded from the order (Dkt. 81, 20 March 2025): the court's outcome for each claim of the map, for the movants' side. 'lost': the court ruled against it. 'exposed': the court left it open. 'secure': the court accepted it or nothing in the order goes against it.

el-hartford-duty-to-defend.why: Duty to defend on appeal may have existed; breach not decided (p. 3 and n. 1)

sub-ai-status-hartford.why: Insured under the endorsement, not the coverage form's Lessors of Land provision (p. 1)

sub-no-fault-requirement.why: 'Caused, in whole or in part' means proximate cause (p. 2)

sub-post-judgment-interest.why: No duty to indemnify, so no post-judgment interest (p. 3)

el-ace-additional-insured.why: Not decided against; the order treats Ace as possibly owing a defense (p. 3)

el-priority-of-coverage.why: Ohio before Hartford; American Fire before Ace (pp. 3-4)

sub-hartford-primary.why: Hartford is excess; the lease does not set priority (pp. 3-4)

sub-ohio-second.why: Ohio Security is primary, not second (p. 3)
